title: Khangurra Reaches Junior Worlds Semis, Guarantees India a Medal
indian_angle: Jagsher Singh Khangurra's advancement to the semifinals guarantees India at least a bronze medal at the prestigious BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: Jagsher Singh Khangurra defeated Yuan-Syue Jhuang to advance to the semifinals of the Cairo BWF World Junior Championships, securing a medal for India. He will next face Radithya Bayu Wardhana.

title: BAI Forms New Athletes Committee for Player Welfare
indian_angle: The formation of the BAI Athletes Committee ensures that Indian badminton players will have a direct voice in the governance and development of the sport.
summary: Badminton Association of India announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee, aimed at providing a platform for players to contribute to decision-making and address their concerns.

title: National Camp Underway for BWF World Junior Championships
indian_angle: This national coaching camp at NCE Guwahati is crucial for preparing India's top junior talent for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships in Cairo.
summary: India's junior badminton squad is undergoing an intensive national coaching camp at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, in preparation for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 in Cairo, Egypt.

title: BAI Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course Concludes in Guwahati, Raipur
indian_angle: The successful completion of the BAI Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course signifies a commitment to enhancing coaching standards across India.
summary: The Badminton Association of India successfully conducted its Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur, from September 14th to 23rd, 2026, to upskill domestic coaches.

title: Regulations Released for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: The release of regulations for the Inter State Team Championships outlines the framework for a key domestic tournament, fostering competition among Indian states.
summary: Badminton Association of India has released the official regulations for the upcoming Inter State Team Championships 2026, detailing rules and guidelines for participation and conduct.

title: 3x15 Scoring System Adopted for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This new 3x15 scoring system aims to make domestic junior tournaments more dynamic and engaging for young Indian players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has implemented a new 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
